Voters chose 300 electors from party lists and electoral unions; votes and seats are the electors' vote and electors won, and shares are computed from the table's votes. The college size (300) is the table's electors added up, and matches the college's final-ballot votes. The electoral college elected Juho Kusti Paasikivi (National Coalition Party) with 171 of 300 votes (Paasikivi 171, Pekkala 67, Kekkonen 62). The winner flag marks the National Coalition Party list, Paasikivi's party. Turnout is computed from the table's votes cast (valid and invalid) and electorate.

elections.notes: Voters chose 301 electors from party lists and electoral unions; votes and seats are the electors' vote and electors won, and shares are computed from the table's votes. The college size (301) is the table's electors added up, and matches the college's final-ballot votes. The electoral college elected Mauno Koivisto (Social Democratic Party) with 189 of 301 votes on the second ballot (first ballot Koivisto 144, Väyrynen 68, Holkeri 63, Kivistö 26, Kajanoja 0; second ballot Koivisto 189, Väyrynen 68, Kivistö 26, Holkeri 18). Turnout is computed from the table's votes cast (valid and invalid) and electorate. In the direct vote held at the same time, Mauno Koivisto won 1,513,234 of 3,094,449 valid votes (48.9%), short of a majority, so the electoral college decided.
